content:
A collection of modules to use CV with Orac.

modules include
- cv clock
- cv note input/out
- cv mpe output 
- cv modulation input 
- cv output 
- cv in/out from audio channels 


Status : beta,  work in progress 
(This will become part of the Orac factory modules)



Requirements : 
- Orac 2.0
- DC Coupled audio Interface 
(will not work with built-in audio card!) 

Platforms:
Will work on Raspberry PI and Organelle (1 & m) 

Installation: 
place in user modules, and configure Orac to use your audio interface.

as this is a kind of preview all support for this is done on the C&G forum... 
please do **not** post questions here,
read the following thread for details on how to setup, and ask questions there. 

https://forum.critterandguitari.com/t/orac-2-cv-tools/4626

I'll likely do a youtube video on this, so subscribe to my channel for news on this and other orac news.
